details:
About SolarScope

SolarScope is an innovative web-based platform designed to explore solar energy potential using NASA satellite and Earth observation data. It transforms scientific information into simple, interactive visualizations that help people understand solar energy availability across different geographical locations.

How It Works

SolarScope uses NASA POWER (Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources) data to explore solar radiation, temperature, and meteorological conditions. The information is presented through an accessible dashboard with charts and location-based insights.

Key Features

  • Solar radiation data exploration.
  • Location-based solar energy analysis.
  • Temperature and weather information.
  • Interactive charts and data visualization.
  • Comparison of solar conditions across locations.
  • Renewable energy awareness and education.

Benefits and Intended Impact

SolarScope aims to make NASA scientific data accessible to students, researchers, environmental enthusiasts, and communities. It encourages awareness of renewable energy and helps users understand how solar resources can support sustainable development.

Technologies and Resources

  • NASA POWER API – Solar and meteorological data.
  • HTML – Webpage structure.
  • CSS – Interface design.
  • JavaScript – Interactive functionality.
  • Chart.js – Data visualization.
  • GitHub – Project hosting and version control.

Creativity and Innovation

The innovative aspect of SolarScope is its ability to transform complex satellite-derived information into understandable visual insights. It connects space science with everyday sustainability challenges and demonstrates the practical value of NASA's open Earth observation resources.

Future Scope

Future developments may include solar panel energy production estimates, historical solar radiation comparisons, additional satellite datasets, and personalized solar energy recommendations.

Conclusion

SolarScope demonstrates how NASA data and digital technology can work together to promote renewable energy awareness and build a more sustainable future. Our vision is to make space-based scientific information useful and accessible to everyone.
